source.title: Proposed Resolution No. 02, A Resolution Setting the Calendar of Sessions for the First Regular Session of the First Bangsamoro Parliament

basis: Republic Act No. 11054 (Bangsamoro Organic Law), Article VII, Sections 22 and 25
meta.note: Read from the scanned resolution, received by Parliament's Bills and Index Division on 24 November 2026; the 'Adopted' line on this copy is blank. The resolution sets the days each sitting week resumes and adjourns; the days between are counted as sitting days. It is subject to change as Parliament may determine. Parliament also convened on 24 November 2026, under Memorandum Order No. 1126-008, to adopt its Rules of Procedure and this calendar.
